ticks.item: MIDDLE EAST - NEW RUNG INSTANCE: SAUDI EAST-WEST PIPELINE SHUT + IRAQI-ORIGIN ATTACK. Saudi Arabia shut the 1,200-km East-West (Petroline) pipeline 'as a precaution' after a drone attack hit it Thursday morning in the Riyadh and Medina regions (satellite imagery: black smoke south of Medina; injuries + damage being assessed per Saudi foreign ministry). The line was moving 4-5M bpd = 4-5% OF GLOBAL SUPPLY (Reuters, ship trackers/analysts) and had bypassed the Hormuz logjam. ATTACK ORIGINATED IN IRAQ per both Baghdad and Riyadh - Iranian-backed militias; Iraq dismissed the Maysan-province commander Saturday, closed the Shalamcheh border crossing with Iran as a precaution; widescale operation under way to find those responsible; Saudi holds retaliation at the Iraqi PM's request, reserves right to 'take all measures necessary'. Saudi crude supply fell to lowest in MORE THAN THREE DECADES (IEA Friday, partly due to Bab el-Mandeb transiting attacks).

MIDDLE EAST - BAB AL-MANDEB FULL CONSOLIDATION (IN-WINDOW corroboration of the Perim rung): Xinhua 00:47Z IN-WINDOW - Houthis 'seize Yemen's entire western coast after taking Bab al-Mandeb Strait area'; Iranian media via MEE 00:31Z (window edge) - Houthis 'take control of Strait of Mandeb after seizing Mayyun Island'; AFP Saturday wire (NAMPA) - Houthis 'controlled Yemen's entire Red Sea coast on Saturday'; SBS: 'Everything has fallen' + 'complete total takeover... as oil tops US$100 and Saudi pipeline shuts down'; India Today Sep 12: capture 'sharpens risks to Saudi oil routes'; Irish Independent 04:30Z IN-WINDOW: island gives 'Iran new advantage in US war'. Yemeni govt forces indicate they will try to RETAKE captured areas. Iran ordered Houthis last week to ESCALATE attacks on Saudi Arabia and promised more funding, weapons and senior officers (Reuters Thursday, 2 Iranian sources). MBS called Trump AT LEAST TWICE Thursday to request US military help (Reuters 2 sources, confirming Axios) - Washington declined direct action for now (intel + targeting only); Saudi asked Washington for help with the Houthis.

MIDDLE EAST - HORMUZ DIPLOMACY TRACK (de-escalation watch): Iran says it will discuss the Strait of Hormuz with Gulf states MONDAY in Oman (Al Jazeera + Asharq Al-Awsat Sep 11; Iran FM: meeting is to 'promote better understanding among the countries of the region'); World Oil: 'Gulf states, Iran weigh talks on reopening Strait of Hormuz' (Sep 11 15:07Z); Amwaj: GCC-Iran-Iraq to gather in Oman as Trump sours on diplomacy; NBC: mediators focus on reopening Hormuz - Araghchi Friday: 'putting diplomacy back on track isn't impossible' but warned on US economic pressure. Monday meeting = scheduled catalyst for next cycles; US-facilitated >10M bpd counter-narrative and transits-7 leg stand.
